{{Quote|Follow the Whispering River to the Canyons of Mist. At the third bend, look high on the canyon wall. There in a cave dwells the beast. Fair winds to all.|Vulgarr|<ref name="teebo" />}}
The '''Canyons of Mist''' were a series of canyons on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] warriors of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] were once directed to a cave there by the [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Vulgarr/Legends|Vulgarr]], who claimed that a monster lived there who had kidnapped [[Malani|one of their young]]. However, this was all part of a scheme in which Vulgarr himself planned to kidnap the [[Wokling/Legends|woklings]] while the warriors were away; Instead of a monster, the Ewok warriors found another Dulok named [[Ulgo]].<ref name="teebo" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Canyons of Mist were created by [[Joe Johnston]] for his [[1984]] book ''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''.<ref name="teebo" />
